23. Work Force Structure: Positions
Procedure
Navigate to Setup and Maintenance.
Search for Manage Extensible Flexfields.
Search for PER_POSITIONS_LEG_EFF.
Select the result row.
Open Actions menu near the upper section of the table.
Click Refresh and Deploy Offline.
Wait for deployment to complete.
Search for PER_POSITIONS_EIT_EFF.
Select the result row.
Open Actions menu.
Click Refresh and Deploy Offline.
Expected Results
Task completes successfully without Oracle validation or save errors.
